citation: Detroit Publishing Co. The Pullman residence, Chicago. c. 1900. Library of Congress Prints and Photographs Division, LC-D4-12552; LC-DIG-det-4a08066; item 2016794585.
author: Detroit Publishing Co., publisher
repository: Library of Congress Prints & Photographs Division, Detroit Publishing Company Photograph Collection. Prairie library image a16-pullman-det-4a08066; the project's reference copy is the image store's (kevinrhaas/chicago-images, prairie-1904/files/a16-pullman-det-4a08066.jpg).
locator: The whole print, taken on 18th Street west of Calumet Avenue beside the Fort Dearborn massacre monument, looking west-north-west along the Pullman property's 18th Street side: the house's south flank and west portico beyond, the low coping wall along the 18th Street walk, and the shrubs and ivy inside it.
rights_note: Library of Congress: no known restrictions on publication. Only forms, counts and places are read from it; nothing is derived from the image as an asset.
access_notes: Read 2026-10-27 (T-3203) from the image store's reference copy, 1024 x 809 px greyscale, sha256 297e4d7b05312c70ddea6e5dbb24a74cffd0db743f3bb9cdcbb1f4c0edc5f4fb (the Prairie library records the derivative it fetched from tile.loc.gov as sha256 d16d8788bddf1e761641d6387feb0f2dd6862168b68a7233da6bf20cec9e5f40; the store's copy is a re-encoding of it at the same size).
note: The companion of LC-D4-12551 (loc_det_4a08065_pullman_residence), taken from the other end of the 18th Street front. Inside the low coping along the 18th Street walk it shows a dense, continuous border of shrubs at about the coping's height and more, east of the house, and ivy over the house's lower walls and portico piers; a fire hydrant stands at the curb. Read for T-3203's front-yard planting.
what_it_supplies: the shrub border inside the coping along 18th Street, east of the Pullman house
ivy on the Pullman house's lower walls and portico piers
what_it_does_not_supply: colour or species: the print is monochrome and the shrubs are read only as masses
the Prairie Avenue front yard's planting, which 4a08065 shows
